title_sq: Super Apartament Luksoz tek Mine Peza!
description_sq:
Super Apartament i invetuar ne detaje ne zone qendrore, lehtesishte e akseueshme nga unaza e vogel, bulevardi Zogu i Pare dhe Rruga e Durrsit. Me nje vendodhje strategjike zona ju mundeson facilitete.
Apartamenti eshte i sapo investir ne instalime elektrike hidraulike, parketi super cilsor dhe elektroshtepiake.
Cdo gje gati, mungojne veshjet personale.
Per nje viziten ne prone, me kontaktoni!
title_en: Super Luxury Apartment in Mine Peza!
description_en: Super apartment renovated in detail in the central area, easily accessible from the small ring road, Zogu i Pare boulevard and Durrsit Street. With a strategic location, the area offers you facilities. The apartment has just been invested in plumbing, high-quality parquet and electrical appliances. Everything is ready, personal clothing is missing. For a visit to the property, contact me!
